description: This Java source file defines the class 'GenericHelperDAO', which implements data access operations for generic entities within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting entities, as well as querying with conditions and handling relations.

classes.name: GenericHelperDAO
classes.description: A data access object class providing generic CRUD and query operations for entities in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity in the database from a GenericValue.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue entity by its primary key.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Retrieves a partial GenericValue entity by primary key, selecting only specified fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves multiple entities by a list of primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Deletes an entity identified by its primary key.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Finds entities matching specified conditions, returning an iterator.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Finds entities related through multiple relations.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Updates an entity in the database.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Updates entities matching a condition with specified fields.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Validates and optionally updates the data source schema.
